stem: What was the main result of the events referred to in these headlines?

options.label: A
options.text: The growth of insurance and welfare programs for elderly citizens

options.label: B
options.text: The growth of radical political parties on the East Coast

options.label: C
options.text: The expansion of political and economic opportunities for minority citizens

options.label: D
options.text: The expansion of economic cooperation between northern and southern states
